change.summary: Retire Create, its add-ons, Immersive Aircraft, KubeJS Create and JEM Drill Lifecycle from the managed client and ordinary local Server.

modifiers.before: Create trains and Immersive Aircraft provided active quest and achievement routes.
modifiers.after: Early ground mounts lead to a mid-game Subterranodon flight quest and a late-game Elytra quest.

modifiers.before: Create blocks, contraptions, trains and aircraft were registered world content.
modifiers.after: No automatic conversion exists. Operators must back up the old world and dismantle removed content before first startup with the reduced pack.

cause.owner: Managed pack and JEM canonical sources

rationale.purpose: Remove the complete dependency and integration chain instead of deleting only JAR files.
rationale.user_requested: Remove all listed Create and aircraft content from client and server while preserving unrelated systems and providing an existing-world migration plan.
rationale.codex_choices: Keep exact third-party integrations only when their installed metadata declares Create optional, reuse existing horse and Subterranodon mechanics, and add one non-consuming Elytra inventory quest.

introduced.summary: Removed the complete active Create and Immersive Aircraft dependency chain.

history.summary: Removed mods, integrations, quests, resources, policy, configuration and generated registry surfaces from both local distribution sides.
Archived source paths removed with Create, Immersive Aircraft and their retired integrations

relations: removed registries -> missing world objects on chunk load
notes: Historical release and research evidence remains history and is not active pack content.
Optional Create support inside retained third-party mods does not install or require Create.
unresolved: Player acceptance and existing-world migration must be completed from a backup before production release.
